svg.title: Without positions ViT sees a bag of patches
svg.desc: The original patch order and a shuffled order are the same set of tokens to a position-free transformer.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Without positions, a shuffled image is the same input
